questions.subject: GRAPHIC_DESIGN
questions.learningObjective: evaluate brand guidelines in a design critique
questions.stem: On Brand guidelines: a designer reviewing a museum exhibition poster notices that a company documents how its logo, colors, and type should be applied. What is the main benefit of such documentation?

options.text: Consistent and correct application by anyone using the identity
The complete elimination of all future design work
options.misconception: overstates the role that a written document can play

options.text: A guarantee of legal ownership of the visual identity
options.misconception: confuses rules for usage with formal legal registration

options.text: Automatic adaptation to every new medium without effort
options.misconception: mistakes documentation for the design work itself

questions.explanation: Brand guidelines record how the identity elements should be used so that different people apply them consistently. They reduce errors and drift, though they do not replace judgment or automatically solve each new design challenge.
questions.hint: Who benefits from having written rules about using an identity?
